rationale: Mufaddal brings deep embedded systems and automotive software expertise (embedded Linux, OTA updates, connectivity) while Yuichiro is advancing materials informatics and polymer force field optimization at Resonac—a complementary pairing where automotive-grade embedded systems could intersect with next-generation battery and material science innovation. Both are independent researchers/spectators at the event with experience across large organizations (LiveWire/VW and Resonac) who may find value in exploring how computational materials research could inform embedded systems design in emerging EV and energy storage applications.
intro_message: mufaddal.esmael@gmail.com, meet Asoma Yuichiro — a materials informatics researcher at Resonac working on polymer force fields and solid-state capacitors who might benefit from your automotive embedded systems and OTA architecture background.
